paper.title: SAGE: Multi-Agent Self-Evolution for LLM Reasoning
paper.central_claim: A closed-loop framework where Challenger, Planner, Solver and Critic co-evolve from a shared LLM backbone using only a small seed set; Critic filters questions/plans; improves reasoning benchmarks across model scales.

evidence.quote: forming a self-rewarding cycle trained end-to-end using task-relative policy gradients.
evidence.support_explanation: The self-evolution loop is closed by policy-gradient training.

evidence.quote: jointly updates the shared backbone using Task-Relative REINFORCE++ with per-role advantage normalization
evidence.support_explanation: All four roles share one backbone; the update step modifies model weights.

evidence.quote: All agents are initialized from their corresponding base models.
evidence.support_explanation: Roles are weight copies of one LLM (LoRA rank 128 per Sec.5.1); no prompt/skill/tool/memory artifact is the retained object.

evidence.quote: (4) all agents are jointly updated using Task-Relative REINFORCE++ with per-role advantage normalization.
evidence.support_explanation: Confirms the retained output of each iteration is updated weights; the question pool D is training data for those weights.

signatures.object: Shared LLM backbone weights (LoRA) acting as Challenger/Planner/Solver/Critic; self-generated question pool D as training data
signatures.information: ~500 seed (question, verifier) items; Solver pass rate under external verifier; Critic scalar scores
signatures.operation: Challenger generates (q,v); Critic filters (alpha=0.7); Planner/Solver answer; verifier reward
signatures.output: Updated model weights; expanded verified question pool
signatures.selection_rule_data: Critic threshold on generated questions and plans; verifier validity
signatures.persistence: Weights (LoRA) and growing question pool used as RL training data
signatures.later_use: Later RL steps train on pool; reported model is the trained backbone
signatures.failure_boundary: Authors note over-specialization after step ~120 and need for early stopping
